methodology: This story is generated from Apple's public Marketing Tools RSS chart feeds. Each country ranking is converted into a score where rank 1 receives 100 points, rank 2 receives 99, and so on; country scores are summed into the published frame. Scheduled StoryOps runs append snapshots so history grows from observed public charts.
